name: Αγία Τριάδα
evidence: Agia Triada is the port/settlement area of Othonoi (Ammos village, with Ammos Hotel + 'Ammos Beach Bar Agia Triada'); the island's main port beach 'consists of fine sand mixed with white pebbles'. Disambiguated to Othonoi (not the Corfu-Palaiokastritsa or Thessaloniki Agia Triada) via lat/lng 39.84/19.41.

name: Αγία Παρασκευή
evidence: Kefalonia's Agia Paraskevi between Sami and Agia Efimia is a pebbly beach ('white pebbles and blue waters, descend a few steps'). Disambiguated to Kefalonia (not the Thesprotia/Perdika beach of the same name) via coords near Sami 38.28/20.62.

name: Παραλία Κόλπος Κορμοράνων
evidence: Kormoranon (Cormorant Bay) is 'a beautiful secluded pebbly cove' on the Fanari-to-Argostoli coastal road near Lassi; matches lat/lng 38.19/20.47. Our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) both correct.

name: Πλατιά Άμμος
evidence: Platia Ammos (Paliki peninsula, ~400 steps down) 'shore is carpeted with fine white pebbles, though some areas have pebbles so small they create the impression of a sandy beach'. Name means 'wide sand' but it is pebble. Coords 38.22/20.35 = Paliki west coast.

name: Φανάρι
evidence: Fanari on Meganisi is 'characterized by fine white pebbles... has the finest pebbles of all the beaches on the island'. Disambiguated to Meganisi via coords 38.67/20.81 (cape Atherino).

name: Μεγάλη Μυζήθρα
evidence: Greek Wikipedia/guides: the Megali Myzithra beach strip below the white conical Myzithres rocks is 'κυρίως καλυμμένη με βότσαλα' (mostly covered with pebbles), boat-access only. Coords 37.65/20.82 = SW Zakynthos cliffs.

name: Ναγός
evidence: Chios Travel Guide (Nagos, NE Chios near Kardamyla): 'αποτελείται από μικρά βότσαλα ενώ στο εσωτερικό έχει χοντρή άμμο' (small pebbles with coarse sand in the inner part). Coords 38.56/26.08 = NE Chios.

name: Παραλία Μυρσινίδι
evidence: Chios.gr (Mersinidi, Vrontados near the monastery): two beaches N and S of the church, 'αποτελούνται από άμμο και βότσαλο' (sand and pebbles), unorganized with natural shade. Coords 38.43/26.14 = Vrontados.

name: Σαλάγωνα
evidence: Chios.gr (Salagona, SW Chios ~6km from Pyrgi): 'a quiet, relatively isolated beach with coarse sand and fine pebbles'. Coords 38.22/25.91 = SW Chios (not the Karfas fine-sand beach).

name: Παραλία Ξυλοσύρτη
evidence: Xylosyrtis (S Ikaria, S of Agios Kirykos): 'a peaceful, long, pebble beach... white beach with glittering pebbles'. Described as pebble-rock but predominantly pebbles. Coords 37.59/26.25 = Xylosyrtis village. Our label βράχια and OSM ROCKS both overstate the rock.

name: Γκλιάτη
evidence: Gliati at Palaia/Ancient Epidavros: 'about 500m long, with sand and fine pebbles and clean blue waters' (sunken Roman ruins offshore). Coords 37.63/23.16 = Palaia Epidavros, not Porto Heli.

name: Παραλία Αρβανιτιά
evidence: Arvanitia, the town beach of Nafplio below Palamidi, is 'made up of white pebbles and rocks... umbrellas on the pebbles, becomes rocky at its edges'. Coords 37.56/22.80 = Nafplio.

name: Παραλία Ασίνης
evidence: Ancient Asini beach near Tolo: 'small and large pebbles on the shore... pebbles and sand, with rocky areas on the right side' (Plaka/larger Asini offers sand, fine and coarse pebbles). Coords 37.53/22.88 = Asini/Tolo. Leans pebble-dominant.

name: Κανταρέ
evidence: Kantare (west of Corinth, before Lechaio) is consistently described as 'a sandy beach with shallow waters, perfect for families' across multiple Corinthia guides. Coords 37.93/22.90 = near Lechaio. Both our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) appear wrong.

name: Παραλία Αγία Σωτήρα
evidence: Agia Sotira (Loutraki-Perachora-Agioi Theodoroi coast): 'the coastline is covered with fine pebbles, while in the eastern section the beach has more rocks'. Coords 38.05/23.03 = near Agioi Theodoroi.

name: Παραλία Λυκοποριάς
evidence: Lykoporia (Xylokastro-Evrostini coast) is described with 'γαλαζοπράσινα νερά και αμμουδερό βυθό' (sandy seabed) and grouped among the area's sandy beaches ('αμμουδιές'); no source specifies pebble shore. Coords 38.14/22.49. Weakly corroborates our label; kept.

name: Παραλία Σκαλωσιά
evidence: Skalosia (Loutraki, below Geraneia mtns): 'this beach with its large white pebbles and deep turquoise waters', access via stairs of sea-stones to 'the pebble beach'. Coords 38.07/22.94.

name: Βορδόνας
evidence: Greeka (Vordonas, ~15km from Gythio near Skoutari, East Mani): 'a mostly sandy coastline, except for some rocks... rocky seafloor; predominantly sandy'. Coords 36.66/22.50. Our label and OSM (both SAND) correct.

name: Λιμάνι
evidence: Generic beach name 'Λιμάνι' (harbor) at coords 36.75/22.80 (Laconian Gulf, roughly between Skala and Asopos) could not be pinned to any beach-specific source without name collision (many 'Λιμάνι/Λιμένι' beaches in Lakonia). Keeping our current label (άμμος).

name: Χαρακιά
evidence: Charakia in Xylis bay (S of Plytra, NW coast of Archangelos bay): 'a sandy beach of 3.5km... golden sand, deep turquoise waters, and colorful pebbles where the waves break', some rocks in the water. Coords 36.66/22.88 confirm Plytra/Archangelos (not the East-Mani Kotronas 'Charakia'). Predominantly sand; our label and OSM (SAND) correct.
